automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.policy: Include only public sources with visible publication or update dates inside the strict two-day window. Exclude missing, ambiguous, future-dated, or boundary-only dates.

federation_boundary.local_scope: AI-assisted development practice: context architecture, guidance structure, source workflows, agent operating practices, verification, governance, and adoption patterns.
federation_boundary.upstream_scope: The upstream AI wiki owns broad companies, models, products, developer tools, agentic frameworks, MCP servers, and general techniques.
federation_boundary.rule_applied: Entity updates are marked upstream-owned; findings preserve only local practice implications or routing notes.

qualifying_findings.source_title: The Limits of Prompt-Based Self-Improvement in Language Model Agents: Meta-Optimization and Failure Attribution
qualifying_findings.visible_date_basis: Event page lists 2026-07-29 14:30:00 to 15:30:00 and Details date Wednesday, July 29 (2026-07-29).
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: The thesis presentation reports that persistent-memory prompt optimizer variants built on Agentic Context Engineering did not reliably improve over ACE on AppWorld, showed no improvement on Toolathlon, and used an evidence-grounded pipeline to attribute failures in long agent trajectories.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Local eval guidance should treat non-improving agent runs as possible evidence of ambiguous specs, missing task information, brittle evaluators, or unstable services before blaming prompts or models.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Add failure-attribution taxonomy and trajectory evidence requirements to software-engineering eval and regression-repair workflows.
qualifying_findings.follow_up_notes: Route broad benchmark/entity background upstream if ingested; local leaf should focus on attribution workflow and evaluator trust.

qualifying_findings.visible_date_basis: Course page lists next cohort July 28, 2026, 12:30-3:30pm EDT.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: The workshop frames context engineering as a system of agent files, custom skills, and automated hooks, with CLAUDE.md split across project, folder, and user levels and hooks used as guardrails.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Practice signals continue moving from single prompt files toward layered instruction ecosystems, reusable skill contracts, and hook-based enforcement that does not consume context-window space.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Compare local AGENTS.md and skill guidance against a layered context model: team conventions, project facts, personal preferences, workflow skills, and pre/post/stop hooks.
qualifying_findings.follow_up_notes: Avoid duplicating Claude Code product coverage; preserve only practice patterns for durable agent instruction architecture.

qualifying_findings.source_title: This Y Combinator startup just raised $13.5 million to stop developers from tokenmaxxing
qualifying_findings.visible_date_basis: Article timestamp is visible in page HTML.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: Business Insider reports that Weave raised $13.5 million for software that measures human and AI coding-tool output and aims to reduce incentives for high-volume AI use as a proxy for productivity.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Team adoption guidance needs metrics that separate useful engineering output from raw token volume, AI activity counts, or lines-of-code-like quantity measures.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Adoption dashboards should include outcome quality and cost governance, not agent-usage leaderboards that reward overuse.
qualifying_findings.follow_up_notes: If ingested, create a local downstream lens for AI-assisted development measurement rather than a company page.

qualifying_findings.source_title: Creator of Anthropic's Claude Code wants you to stop micromanaging your AI
qualifying_findings.visible_date_basis: Article timestamp is visible in page HTML and is inside the strict cutoff window.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: The article reports Boris Cherny's advice to specify the desired outcome, boundaries, and success criteria instead of over-prescribing every implementation step for modern coding agents.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Prompt guidance should distinguish durable guardrails and acceptance criteria from unnecessary step-level micromanagement that may block stronger agent planning.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Instruction templates can be revised toward outcome, constraints, verification evidence, and rollback boundaries while leaving implementation path discovery to the agent when risk allows.
qualifying_findings.follow_up_notes: Potential follow-up under prompt-and-instructions as a local practice note on outcome-oriented prompting.

qualifying_findings.source_title: Agentic AI Night - MCP Release Party
qualifying_findings.visible_date_basis: Event page states that on July 28, 2026 MCP graduates and describes the July 28 event.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: The event page says MCP's 2026-07-28 spec changes agent deployment at scale with stateless protocol core, OAuth 2.1 hardening, and an extensions framework, plus sessions on production architecture and governance.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: MCP-as-practice guidance should include migration and governance readiness, not just tool connectivity. Stateless deployment affects load balancing, approval, observability, and enterprise rollout planning.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Update local governed-MCP practice to treat protocol revisions as deployment lifecycle events with migration plans, approval gates, and traceability expectations.
qualifying_findings.follow_up_notes: Broad MCP spec coverage belongs upstream; keep local lens to managed tool practice and rollout controls.

qualifying_findings.source_title: MCP 2026-07-28: Stateless Transport, MCP Apps, and What Enterprises Must Migrate
qualifying_findings.visible_date_basis: Article page lists July 28, 2026 as publication date.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: The article summarizes MCP 2026-07-28 migration implications: no Mcp-Session-Id, no initialize handshake, explicit handles for application state, multi-round-trip requests for elicitation, routing headers, and migration planning for deprecated features.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Local MCP governance guidance should capture the operational shift from hidden transport state to explicit tool-returned handles that agents can reason about and pass across workflow steps.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Agent tool workflows should audit session dependence, define explicit state handles, and add request/response trace points before migrating remote MCP servers.
qualifying_findings.follow_up_notes: Pair with official MCP source if ingested; record BOVO as implementation commentary, not protocol authority.

qualifying_findings.source_title: The Harness Era: Why Enterprise AI Architecture Matters More Than Model Selection
qualifying_findings.visible_date_basis: Search result and article page identify publication as July 28, 2026.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: Moody's argues that harness design is becoming more strategic than model selection, recommending thin orchestration, skill files, resolvers that load only needed context, model portability, and auditable data connectors.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Application-pattern guidance should explicitly separate harness code, skill/process artifacts, context resolvers, and authoritative data connectors to control token cost and auditability.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Add a candidate downstream lens for thin harness architecture as a cost, portability, and audit control pattern.
qualifying_findings.follow_up_notes: Use as practice-oriented enterprise architecture evidence; do not create local company or provider pages.

qualifying_findings.source_title: Context Compaction Showdown: How Codex CLI, Claude Code, and 5 Other Agents Handle Full Context Windows
qualifying_findings.visible_date_basis: Article page shows original date April 10, 2026 and updated date July 29, 2026.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: The updated article compares context-compaction strategies across coding agents, including dual-path compaction, summary prefixes, encrypted compaction payloads, multi-mechanism cleanup, tail preservation, and summary verification.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Context architecture guidance should treat compaction as an explicit reliability and security design surface, not an invisible model feature.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Potential local leaf: compaction acceptance criteria covering retained recent context, summarized decisions, prompt-injection resistance, non-looping behavior, and auditability.
qualifying_findings.follow_up_notes: If ingested, verify claims against primary tool docs or source before treating agent-specific mechanisms as durable facts.

qualifying_findings.source_title: Watch Laracon US 2026 Live on YouTube
qualifying_findings.visible_date_basis: Article page says published on July 28th, 2026.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: Laravel News lists Laracon sessions including 'From Vibe Coding to Vibe Engineering,' 'Building a CLI Coding Agent from Scratch,' 'Building for Agents & Humans,' and 'Think Harder: How I Prompt.'
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Mainstream framework conferences are surfacing practice-level agent topics alongside ordinary engineering content, which is an adoption signal for team training and operating model pages.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Track conference-session themes as adoption evidence, not as authoritative implementation guidance unless session materials become available.
qualifying_findings.follow_up_notes: Potential follow-up: look for public recordings/transcripts before ingesting substantive claims.
